description: HydraShield LinkedIn campaigns A–G (docs/LINKEDIN_STRATEGY.md). Drafts live in marketing/content/drafts/; publishing is human-executed. No fabricated metrics: the metrics fields name what will be measured, not invented values.

campaigns.name: Climate risk for insurers
campaigns.objective: Reach underwriting and risk roles with evidence-labelled hazard intelligence
campaigns.pain: Portfolio exposure needs traceable, per-location evidence instead of black-box scores
campaigns.evidence: Real per-location analysis with provenance; historical event records; screening-indicator honesty
campaigns.follow_up: For responders: offer a monitoring pilot on a small book of locations

campaigns.name: Climate exposure for real-estate companies
campaigns.objective: Reach asset/investment roles with site-level exposure evidence
campaigns.pain: Site selection and disclosure need documented climate exposure with sources
campaigns.evidence: Six-hazard site screening; coastal/flood exposure; PDF reports with traceable methodology
campaigns.cta: Run your site through the analysis
campaigns.follow_up: For responders: full report + monitoring of owned assets

campaigns.name: Climate intelligence for investors
campaigns.objective: Reach investment/portfolio roles with due-diligence-grade exposure context
campaigns.pain: Due diligence lacks traceable climate evidence with stated uncertainty
campaigns.evidence: Exposure profiles, historical evidence, monitoring for held assets; uncertainty stated
campaigns.follow_up: For responders: multi-location screening pilot + API discussion

campaigns.name: Extreme-weather intelligence for municipalities
campaigns.objective: Reach municipal resilience/civil-protection roles with territory monitoring
campaigns.pain: Territory-level current + historical hazard intelligence and alerts that reach people
campaigns.evidence: Territory maps, population exposure, monitoring with SMS/email alerts on meaningful change
campaigns.follow_up: For responders: municipal monitoring pilot walkthrough

campaigns.name: Earth-observation intelligence for researchers
campaigns.objective: Reach research directors with reproducible, provenance-carrying analysis
campaigns.pain: Reproducibility and method comparison need provenance and open registries
campaigns.evidence: Content-hashed analysis runs; public source/model/ground-truth registries; API + SDKs

campaigns.name: Climate resilience for infrastructure companies
campaigns.objective: Reach infrastructure/asset roles in energy, logistics, ports, telecom, data centers
campaigns.pain: Asset exposure to wildfire, wind, flood, heat and coastal conditions; early warning for operations
campaigns.evidence: Asset screening, hazard-aware siting intelligence, monitoring + SMS alerts

campaigns.name: Sustainable solutions intelligence
campaigns.objective: Reach practitioners evaluating adaptation options for specific places
campaigns.pain: Adaptation options need site-fit, limitations and evidence — not vendor claims
campaigns.evidence: Solutions Intelligence: site-matched solution classes and packages with limitations and sources
campaigns.follow_up: For responders: solutions deep-dive on their site
